# confluencedc_space (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing Confluence space by its key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "confluencedc_space" "engineering" {
  key = "ENG"
}

output "engineering_space_name" {
  value = data.confluencedc_space.engineering.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The unique key of the space, e.g. "ENG".

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The plain-text space description.
- `id` (String) The internal numeric ID of the space.
- `name` (String) The display name of the space.
- `type` (String) The type of the space, e.g. "global" or "personal".
